Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original transparent pixel-art vehicle sheet for a richly detailed cozy 2D cutaway neighbourhood.
Primary request: FOUR beautifully drawn realistic-proportion everyday small-town passenger vehicles, consistent with finely detailed hand-painted pixel-art people and a lush timber studio background. Replace a crude tiny block-car with convincing vehicles.
Layout exactly TWO rows by TWO columns, equal cells, full vehicle entirely within each cell with transparent padding. True side view, very slightly elevated camera, all vehicle fronts face RIGHT, both wheels fully visible on an identical horizontal ground baseline. Vehicle body length should be about 3.3 times total vehicle height. Strong recognizable car silhouettes, normal window proportions and correct wheelbases, no cartoon toys, no chunky square placeholders. Detailed wheel rubber, alloy/radial hubs, fenders, door seams and handles, side mirrors, windshield, subtle visible driver silhouette inside glass, realistic bumpers, tiny tail lamp. No text, letters, number plates with readable text, logos, trademarks, environment, street or people outside cars.
Cell top-left: muted dark teal compact hatchback, warm highlights, slightly rounded 1990s proportions.
Cell top-right: warm burgundy station wagon, roof rack, calm chrome trim, handsome distinct roofline.
Cell bottom-left: cream small vintage sedan, dark teal roof trim, polished but used, refined rounded bonnet.
Cell bottom-right: slate-blue compact family sedan, subtly different proportions and window shapes.
Medium: crisp carefully clustered high-detail pixel art, subtle dithered texture, small coherent 1-3 pixel highlights, rich muted colour ramps, dark plum outlines, warm golden ambient edges matching a cozy pixel-art studio. NOT vector, NOT generic low-detail game symbols, NOT photorealistic. Headlights off and unlit, transparent background with only a compact subtle grounding shadow directly under each vehicle. Complete integrated car and wheels. No multiple poses of the same car, precisely four distinct cars.
background_extraction:
Use case: background-extraction. Input image is the edit target: the FOUR detailed cars in a 2-by-2 layout.
Remove ONLY every part of the dark gradient backdrop and the large coloured glows behind the cars. Output a TRUE RGBA transparent cutout sprite sheet with alpha=0 outside the four car silhouettes. Keep all four cars, their precise positions and dimensions, side-view camera, warm muted colours, outline pixel clusters, window glass/driver silhouettes, tyres, wheel hubs and every intrinsic vehicle detail EXACTLY unchanged. Do not make car windows transparent; keep their tinted glass artwork. Keep each full vehicle intact. No background at all, no coloured glow, no floor, no vignette, no checkerboard painted into the pixels. Four isolated full cars with actual transparent space all around and between them. No resizing, no rearrangement, no redesign.
